status: authored 2026-10-08; generated by tools/nether_gate.py into build/datapacks/cobblers_nether_gate, world-local, self-driving (no reapply step). NOT RUN in any world: nothing here has been seen to fire, teleport or message anyone. The runtime proofs are experiments/EXP-063-nether-gate, status NOT_EXECUTED.
decision: docs/mechanics/NETHER_ENCOUNTERS.md section 1 'The gate (proposed)' G1 and open question 1 ('The gate: badge 8 (gym8_cleared), by bouncing the player out on arrival? Recommend yes'), approved by the owner (brief of 2026-10-08). It makes the Nether late-game in fact: today nothing gates it and the first obsidian opens it (DIMENSIONS_AND_BORDERS.md:241-242, :279-281, relayed by that document's P1).
rung: functions/commands (CLAUDE.md principle 6). Cobblemon native, the addons and the configs have no dimension gate: Waystones, the portals pack and the vanilla portal all move a player between dimensions with no condition we can set. A datapack advancement on vanilla's minecraft:changed_dimension trigger reacts to an arrival, and a scheduled sweep with a positional selector finds every player standing in the Nether (EXP-047 result 4; the Entei's nether_check, data/entei_boss.json entry.nether_check). No scripting layer, companion or mod.
gate_flag_why: the flag the campaign already treats as badge 8: data/progression.json flags gym8_cleared, a trainer_defeat of the eighth leader of every series (kanto_giovanni and kanto_giovanni_challenge, johto_sandra, hoenn_adriano, sinnoh_corrado), granted per player by tools/progression_pack.py as the advancement cobblers:flag/gym8_cleared. The finale gate reads the same flag (docs/STATE.md, NETHER_ENCOUNTERS.md G1). No new source of truth: tools/nether_gate.py fails closed if data/progression.json stops declaring it or it stops being a trainer_defeat.
dimension_why: the vanilla Nether only. cobblers:pocket (data/portals.json pocket.dimension, where the Entei rooms are) is never gated: the trigger names `to` the Nether and the sweep searches only the Nether, so a player in a pocket room is in neither. tools/nether_gate.py fails closed if this dimension is ever the pocket's.

trigger.status: ASSUMED, not in docs/research: the trigger's id and its `to` field are vanilla's (the wiki's advancement format for 1.21.1), and that it fires for a portal, a /tp and a mod teleport alike (vanilla's ServerPlayer raises it on both its portal and its cross-level teleport paths, as read from memory, not from the jar). EXP-063 cases 1, 4 and 5 check each route. If it never fires, the sweep alone still gates, one period later.
trigger.does: revokes itself (so it fires again on the next arrival), then schedules the sweep for the next tick. It never teleports inside the trigger: the reward runs during the dimension change itself, and moving the player again from inside that change is avoidable risk. One tick in the Nether costs nothing.

sweep.period_why: the backstop for every arrival the trigger cannot see: a respawn at a respawn anchor set before the gate shipped, a login inside the Nether (a player who logged out there, before the gate or within the trigger's one tick), a route that does not raise changed_dimension. Twenty ticks is the Entei keeper's period (data/entei_boss.json keeper.period_ticks): at most one second in the Nether before the bounce.
sweep.box_why: x, y, z, dx, dy, dz of an absolute box larger than any reachable Nether: wider than the world border (-1024..9215, docs/STATE.md) and the vanilla coordinate limit, and taller than any build height, so it selects EVERY player in the Nether, wherever they stand, including above the roof or falling below the floor. Its only purpose is to make the selector positional, so vanilla searches only the execution dimension (EXP-047 result 4, the portals' rescue box pattern, tools/portals.py). A box sized to the border would be a list of where we expect players, not the world (CLAUDE.md 'Our list is not the world').

exempt_why: an operator building or inspecting in creative or spectator is never bounced; survival and adventure players always are. Changing gamemode needs an operator, so this is not a way round the gate for players.

return.to: the player's blackout checkpoint: the Pokemon Center healer or town waystone they last used (data/blackout.json checkpoints), validated by cobblers:blackout/checkpoint/validate and reached by cobblers:blackout/checkpoint/tp, exactly as a blackout returns a player (tools/blackout_pack.py blackout/arrive). Fallback: data/blackout.json pallet.position, read at generation, the fallback the Entei's eject also uses (data/entei_boss.json fallback_out).
return.why: every one of those points is in the overworld and is a place a living player stood (the checkpoint is written from the player's own position when they use the healer or arrive at the waystone, tools/blackout_pack.py blackout/checkpoint/set), never a position this tool computes. Their own portal was rejected: vanilla keeps no record of which overworld portal a player used, a portal can stand inside a structure or a cave the heightmap knows nothing about, and landing a player back IN the portal would send them straight back into the Nether.
return.pallet_measured: data/blackout.json pallet.position (1461, 118, 5306): tools/ground.py measured 2026-10-08 'ground at 1461, 5306 is y117 (heightmap 116.62)', so 118 is the feet level on rounded canonical ground. tools/nether_gate.py fails closed if the pallet's y is not round(ground) + 1.
return.never_traps: the bounce cannot leave a player in the Nether: if the checkpoint path fails for any reason (the blackout pack absent, a macro refused), a positional check in the Nether finds them still there and sends them to the pallet by literal coordinates, which need no other pack. It cannot loop: every destination is in the overworld, none is a portal.
return.does_not_change: the player's checkpoint, spawnpoint, items, money or party. A bounce is not a blackout: nothing is charged and nothing is healed.

dismount: the player is dismounted first (`ride @s dismount`), and anything riding them is dismounted (`execute on passengers run ride @s dismount`), the ferries' and the blackout's form (tools/ferries.py, tools/blackout_pack.py). A mount stays in the Nether; a teleport would split them anyway (ASSUMED vanilla: a cross-dimension tp of a rider stops the riding). What Cobblemon does with a sent-out Pokemon whose owner leaves its dimension is NOT KNOWN here: EXP-063 case 3 reads the party afterwards.
objectives_why: per player: ng.b counts the bounces (diagnostic, read in EXP-063; carried across a re-export with data/scoreboard.dat like every objective), ng.ok is scratch for the one bounce being run. No server-wide state: the gate is a pure function of the player's own advancement and gamemode, so a late joiner, a player who died, a player who disconnected mid-arrival and two players arriving together each resolve on their own record.

message.bounce: The heat turns you back. Eight badges first.

multiplayer.per_player: the gate is per player, like the level cap (NETHER_ENCOUNTERS.md G1 'Multiplayer'). A friend without the eighth badge cannot follow a friend who has it through a shared portal: the holder stays, the other is sent to their own checkpoint. The owner should know this before a co-op night.
multiplayer.together: two players arriving in the same tick both raise the trigger; the sweep they schedule (one, `replace`) judges every player in the Nether, each on their own advancement.
multiplayer.late_join: a player who joins the server, or logs in standing in the Nether, is judged by the next sweep
multiplayer.death: a player who respawns into the Nether (a respawn anchor) is judged by the next sweep; vanilla's respawn is not a dimension change for the trigger (ASSUMED)
multiplayer.disconnect: a player who disconnects in the one tick between the trigger and the sweep is judged by the first sweep after they log back in

entei_interplay: the Entei's sigil is eaten in the Nether and its eject returns the player to the Nether block they ate it in (data/entei_boss.json entry, tools/entei_boss.py eject). Both need champion_cleared, which every normal player reaches only after gym8_cleared; such a player is never bounced. A player holding champion_cleared without gym8_cleared (an operator's grant) would be bounced out of the Nether when the Entei returns them: to their checkpoint, which is safe, and their slot is freed by the Entei keeper as for any player who leaves.
cost: period: 3 command lines every 20 ticks when nobody is bounced (the keeper's sweep call and its schedule, and the sweep's one selector line over at most max-players online players), at the calibrated 1.0-3.8 us per line (docs/mechanics/TOWN_TICK_BUDGET.md section 1b, an upper bound): 3-11.4 us per 20 ticks = 0.15-0.57 us per tick = 0.0003%-0.0011% of the 50 ms budget. A bounce is an event, not a tick cost: about 20 lines of its own plus the blackout's validate (one line per checkpoint), once per arrival. tests/test_nether_gate.py recomputes the per-period line count from the emitted functions.
does_not_cover: the End: End access is post-game and unreachable by decision (DIMENSIONS_AND_BORDERS.md:338); no gate is built for it
items: a badge holder can still carry netherite, Fire Stones or blaze rods out of the Nether and give them to a friend who has no badge. The gate keeps players out, not things
a Pokemon mount left in the Nether by a bounced rider (EXP-063 case 3)

a portal a player builds ON their own checkpoint spot (inside the Center, where they stood to heal): the bounce lands them in it and vanilla carries them back after its portal delay, until they step out. A loop they can walk out of, not a trap (EXP-063 case 11)
a player inside a Cobblemon battle when the sweep finds them (only possible by logging in mid-battle in the Nether): the teleport is vanilla's; what Cobblemon does with the battle is not known
the inherited Nether spawns, the Nether tables and the rings (NETHER_ENCOUNTERS.md sections 1-2): other units
